centreline_propagation_coverage_min.description: §8e L24c (Spec 62) — minimum fraction of valid-geom parcels that must carry centreline_dataset_version_when_enriched before enrich-permits.js propagates is_corner_lot/is_through_lot/primary_frontage_street_name onto permits + coa. Below this, §8d is treated as only partially run and propagation HALTs (would otherwise mark most leads false/false/NULL). 0.9 sits below the ~3% zero-intersection floor so a healthy ~97% run never false-HALTs. CONSUMED by scripts/enrich-permits.js (assertCentrelineEnriched).

road_overlay_distance_m.description: Distance (metres) for the LineString zoning-overlay spatial join (Policy Road, Priority Retail). SEEDED by Spec 58 load-zoning; CONSUMED by the future WF2 enrich-parcels.js via ST_DWithin(parcels.geom::geography, road.geom::geography, road_overlay_distance_m) — the ::geography cast is mandatory (F-C2), else SRID 4326 treats the value as degrees (~111km/deg).

reno_coa_uplift_pct.description: Spec 65 §6 (Phase 2) — CoA variance uplift on the by-law max-build GFA: max_newbuild_coa_gfa_sqm = max_buildable_gfa_sqm × (1 + this). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (scenario pass). Operator-tunable calibration heuristic.

reno_kitchen_gfa_pct.description: Spec 65 §6 (Phase 2) — kitchen-reno floor area as a fraction of the current-home GFA (cur_est_kitchen_gfa_sqm). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js. Operator-tunable.

reno_bath_gfa_pct.description: Spec 65 §6 (Phase 2) — bathroom-reno floor area as a fraction of the current-home GFA (cur_est_bath_gfa_sqm). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js. Operator-tunable.

mislink_footprint_lot_tol.description: Spec 65 §5 (WF3-A) — mislink guard tolerance: existing_footprint > lot_size_sqm × (1 + this) means the WRONG building was linked (block/neighbour attribution); the whole existing structure is NULLed + existing_data_quality_flag='footprint_exceeds_lot'. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js. Operator-tunable.

max_build_min_dimension_m.description: Spec 65 §4 MB-3 (WF3 Phase 1 D-C): minimum viable build dimension (m). A max-build width/length below this floor is NULLed — the setback box is excluded as degenerate; non-ravine envelopes fall back to the coverage cap only (max_buildable_gfa_basis='coverage_only'); ravine sub-floor parcels are 'ravine_constrained' with the whole envelope withheld (no coverage fallback). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js. Operator-tunable.

storey_height_m.description: Spec 65 §6 (Phase 2) — residential storey height (metres) for the height→storey translation (max_build_stories = round(bylaw_max_height_m / storey_height) when the by-law gives no storey count). Non-residential zones use a taller inline value. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

garage_min_lot_sqm.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — minimum lot area (m²) to consider an accessory garage. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

garage_max_gfa_sqm.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — by-law cap on a detached garage footprint (m²). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

garage_min_footprint_sqm.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — minimum usable rear-yard footprint (m²) for a garage to fit (one car). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

accessory_max_coverage_pct.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — max share of usable rear-yard area a garage may cover. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

car_footprint_sqm.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — one parking-stall footprint incl. clearance (m²); garage_capacity_cars = floor(max_garage_gfa / this). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

laneway_suite_max_gfa_sqm.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — by-law cap on a laneway suite GFA (m², ~2-storey). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

laneway_suite_min_lot_sqm.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — minimum lot area (m²) for a laneway suite. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

laneway_suite_min_rear_yard_m.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — minimum usable rear-yard depth (m) for a laneway suite. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

min_soft_landscaping_pct.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — share of the lot that must remain soft landscaping; an accessory pushing greenspace below this is buildable only via a CoA minor variance (drives garage_permission / rear_suite_permission). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

laneway_suite_storeys.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — laneway suite storeys; suite footprint = GFA / storeys for the greenspace test. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

garden_suite_storeys.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — garden suite storeys; suite footprint = GFA / storeys for the greenspace test. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

garden_suite_min_lot_sqm.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — externalized garden-suite min lot area (m²); default = the previously-hardcoded value (byte-stable). CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

garden_suite_min_rear_yard_m.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — externalized garden-suite min usable rear-yard depth (m); default = previously-hardcoded. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

garden_suite_max_gfa_sqm.description: Spec 65 §7 (Phase 3) — externalized garden-suite GFA cap (m²); default = previously-hardcoded. CONSUMED by enrich-parcels.js (max-build pass).

los_multiplier_bid.description: LoS score multiplier applied when a lead is in active bidding phase

los_multiplier_work.description: LoS score multiplier applied when a lead is in active work phase

los_penalty_tracking.description: LoS penalty (points) deducted when a lead has been viewed/tracked without conversion

los_penalty_saving.description: LoS penalty (points) deducted when a lead is saved but not acted on

los_base_cap.description: Maximum LoS base score before multipliers are applied

los_base_divisor.description: Divisor applied to construction cost when computing the LoS base score

stall_penalty_precon.description: Days without phase progression before a pre-construction lead is considered stalled

stall_penalty_active.description: Days without phase progression before an active-construction lead is considered stalled

expired_threshold_days.description: Negative offset (days) used to classify a permit as expired; permits older than this are excluded from leads

liar_gate_threshold.description: Minimum fraction of active permits with cost estimate before the Liar's Gate override triggers (Spec 83 §4)

coa_stall_threshold.description: Days without CoA update before a linked application is considered stalled

coa_stall_threshold_p2_days.description: Phase F.2 CRM Assistant CoA stall threshold for Hearing Scheduled status (Universal Stream B1.B / P2): hearing prep typically runs 1-3 months — NOT a stall. Default 90 = upper edge of typical hearing window. Setting this below coa_stall_threshold defeats the purpose. Seeded in DB by mig 136.

coa_imminent_window_days.description: Phase F.2 CRM Assistant CoA imminent-alert window: fires COA_HEARING_IMMINENT when 0 < (hearing_date - NOW()) <= this many days AND last_notified_urgency != 'imminent'. Default 7 = one week before hearing. Operator-tunable per trade engagement model. Seeded in DB by mig 136.

coa_stall_threshold_postponed_days.description: Phase F.2 CRM Assistant CoA stall threshold for Postponed/Deferred statuses (mid-tier between generic 30-day and Hearing-Scheduled 90-day). Default 60 = upper edge of typical postponement before considered stalled. Operator-tunable per Spec 86 Control Panel. Seeded in DB by mig 154.

inspection_stall_days.description: Days without inspection activity before an Active Inspection permit is reclassified as Stalled

stale_closure_abort_pct.description: Maximum percentage of permits that may be closed in a single run; exceeding this aborts the pipeline as a safety guard against partial CKAN downloads

pending_closed_grace_days.description: Days a permit must remain in Pending Closed status before being promoted to Closed

pre_permit_expiry_months.description: Months after CoA approval before an unlinked Pre-Permit lead is reclassified as Expired/Abandoned

pre_permit_stale_months.description: Months after CoA approval before an unlinked Pre-Permit is flagged as stale in the aging audit (early-warning bucket)

coa_freshness_warn_days.description: Days since last CoA ingestion before assert-coa-freshness emits a portal-rot WARN (data may be frozen in CKAN)

coa_freshness_fail_days.description: WF2 P6.5 — days since last CoA ingestion before assert-coa-freshness escalates from WARN to FAIL (portal likely dead, not just slow). Default 135 ≈ 3× the 45-day WARN floor. Empty-table branch stays WARN (fresh-staging, not portal rot).

scrape_early_phase_threshold_pct.description: Scrape coverage percentage below which the staleness monitor treats stale permits as WARN (early phase) rather than FAIL (production)

scrape_stale_days.description: Days since last scrape_at before a permit inspection is considered stale in the staleness monitor

calibration_min_sample_size.description: Minimum number of historical leads required before trade calibration data is trusted

urban_coverage_ratio.description: GFA coverage ratio applied to urban parcels when estimating construction area (Spec 83 §3)

suburban_coverage_ratio.description: GFA coverage ratio applied to suburban parcels when estimating construction area (Spec 83 §3)

trust_threshold_pct.description: Minimum fraction of permits with parcel-linked cost data before a coverage ratio is trusted (Spec 83 §4)

commercial_shell_multiplier.description: Discount multiplier applied to commercial shell-and-core permits for cost estimation (Spec 86)

placeholder_cost_threshold.description: Construction cost values below this threshold (CAD) are treated as placeholder/zero and excluded from analysis

cost_outlier_ceiling_cad.description: Construction cost ceiling (CAD) above which a permit est_const_cost is flagged as a data-quality outlier (assert-data-bounds E7). $500M was too tight for legitimate Toronto megaprojects (hospitals, transit stations, mixed-use towers); raised to $2B.

desc_null_rate_warn_pct.description: Maximum acceptable percentage of recent permits (last 24h) with a NULL description before a data-quality warning is emitted

builder_null_rate_warn_pct.description: Maximum acceptable percentage of recent permits (last 24h) with a NULL builder_name before a data-quality warning is emitted

cost_est_null_rate_warn_pct.description: Maximum acceptable percentage of NULL estimated_cost rows in cost_estimates before a data-quality warning is emitted

cost_est_min_tiers.description: Minimum number of distinct cost_tier values expected in cost_estimates; fewer triggers a data-quality warning

cost_est_legacy_cost_ceiling_cad.description: P13-1/P13-2: magnitude ceiling (CAD) on cost_estimates.estimated_cost for the LEGACY geometric/permit-passthrough sources (cost_source IN ('model','permit')). Above this a legacy row is treated as implausible (the mislinked-massing tail: whole-campus/whole-block GFA attributed to a single permit — e.g. Sunnybrook 792K m² on an elevator-cab permit). compute-cost-estimates nulls estimated_cost (keeps cost_source) via the durable clamp; assert-data-bounds WARNs on any residual not in the accepted-by-id list. Archetype (lot-validated) sources are exempt — the archetype caps already bound them.

cost_est_legacy_gfa_ceiling_sqm.description: P13-1/P13-2: magnitude ceiling (m²) on cost_estimates.modeled_gfa_sqm for LEGACY sources. A single permit modeling >50,000 m² GFA is almost always mislinked whole-block/campus massing (max observed 1.89M m²). Rows breaching this are nulled by the compute clamp; assert-data-bounds WARNs on residual priced rows (estimated_cost IS NOT NULL) above it.

permit_declared_cost_ceiling.description: P13-2: upper-sentinel ceiling (CAD) on a permit's declared est_const_cost in the Liar's Gate. A declared cost above this is treated as a placeholder (the mirror of PLACEHOLDER_COST_THRESHOLD's lower guard — e.g. the exact-$1e9 round-number filings on 38-39 storey towers) and the geometric model takes over instead of passing the sentinel through as cost_source='permit'. Seeded at $500M: above the largest plausible single-permit declared build, below the $1e9 placeholder band.

calibration_freshness_warn_hours.description: Hours since last compute_timing_calibration run after which the timing_calibration table is considered stale and a warning is emitted

coa_forward_link_sub085_warn_pct.description: P12-B2: max acceptable percentage of LINKED coa_applications whose linked_confidence is below the 0.85 identity floor (a same-street/geo/flagged tier that must not surface as identity). Baseline sub-0.85 share ~54% (17,842 of 33,114 linked, 2026-07-08); seeded at baseline+5 so a regression in link quality WARNs. assert-data-bounds coa section.

lifecycle_unclassified_max.description: Maximum number of non-terminal permits/CoAs with a NULL lifecycle_phase before assert-lifecycle-phase-distribution emits a FAIL (strongest correctness gate)

lifecycle_live_status_null_warn_count.description: WARN threshold for the additive breakout counters in assert-lifecycle-phase-distribution: live_status_null_count (NULL phase + non-dead status + matched_rule IS NULL) and never_classified_count (lifecycle_classified_at IS NULL). Both are dirty-queue drain-lag signals that clear on the next in-chain classify run (per docs/reports/pipeline-validation/2026-07-07-lifecycle-null-trace.md). Default 50 sits above steady-state noise (~1) and below a single day's new-permit load (~500).

lifecycle_status_history_retention_days.description: Days to retain rows in lifecycle_status_history (default 1825 = 5 years per Spec 86 §1). Long retention supports forecast cohort segmentation by traversal pattern across the median 1,078-day CoA→permit lag. Hard floor: must be ≥ 730 to support typical CoA cohort learning. Seeded in DB by mig 136.

scraper_error_rate_warn_pct.description: Proxy error rate percentage at or above which assert-network-health emits a FAIL (proxy_errors / permits_attempted * 100)

scraper_latency_p50_warn_ms.description: Scraper latency p50 (ms) at or above which assert-network-health emits a WARN

scraper_empty_streak_warn.description: Number of consecutive empty scraper responses at or above which assert-network-health emits a WARN (WAF shadow-ban detection)

urgency_overdue_days.description: Days past the predicted start date (as a positive integer) before a trade forecast is classified as 'overdue' rather than 'delayed' (code: daysUntil <= -urgency_overdue_days)

urgency_upcoming_days.description: Days until the predicted start date at or below which a trade forecast is classified as 'upcoming' rather than 'on_time'

score_tier_elite.description: Minimum opportunity_score (0-100) for a lead to be classified as 'elite' tier in the scoring distribution telemetry

score_tier_strong.description: Minimum opportunity_score (0-100) for a lead to be classified as 'strong' tier (below elite) in the scoring distribution telemetry

score_tier_moderate.description: Minimum opportunity_score (0-100) for a lead to be classified as 'moderate' tier (below strong) in the scoring distribution telemetry; scores below this are 'low'

los_decay_divisor.description: Scales the asymptotic decay curve for competition penalties (rawPenalty / this = decayFactor; higher = gentler decay). At 25, a single high-intensity tracker halves the score.

cost_model_coverage_warn_pct.description: Minimum percentage of processed permits that must receive a non-null cost estimate; below this threshold the cost estimate run emits a WARN verdict

cost_model_coverage_fail_pct.description: WF1 Spec 83 §3.A OB-2: model_coverage_pct FAIL threshold. Default 25 = half of PI-3 predicted post-fix coverage (~52%) — catches not just the 14-day exact-zero regression but also half-broken states (e.g., coverage drops from 52% to 5% via partial vocabulary mismatch). Recalibrate via Spec 86 Control Panel after the post-deploy spike settles.

cost_matrix_miss_warn_pct.description: WF1 Spec 83 §3.A OB-3b: matrix_miss_pct WARN threshold. Default 58 = PI-1 predicted miss rate (48%) + 10pp WARN margin. Operator-tunable per Spec 86 Control Panel as the scope_intensity_matrix coverage scales.

cost_matrix_miss_fail_pct.description: WF1 Spec 83 §3.A OB-3b: matrix_miss_pct FAIL threshold. Default 68 = PI-1 predicted miss rate (48%) + 20pp FAIL margin. Catches large-step coverage regressions (e.g., new permit_type vocabulary appearing in CKAN that the matrix doesn't cover). WF2 archetype: DEMOTED to INFO (full-population miss rate is meaningless once T1-T3 bypass the matrix); the gated metric is cost_t4_matrix_miss_*.

cost_t4_matrix_miss_warn_pct.description: WF2 archetype (Spec 83 §3): matrix-miss WARN threshold over the T4 population ONLY (leads on the legacy path: non-residential + mapper-null residential). The T4 denominator keeps the gate meaningful after T1-T3 bypass the matrix — a full-population gate would always pass (Observability plan-review item 1).

cost_t4_matrix_miss_fail_pct.description: WF2 archetype (Spec 83 §3): matrix-miss FAIL threshold over the T4 population — catches a T4-only regression (e.g. matrix vocabulary drift) that the demoted full-population metric can no longer see.

archetype_nofit_residential_warn_pct.description: WF2 archetype (Spec 83 §3): WARN when mapper-null residential leads (the mapper was CALLED and returned no line) exceed this share of residential processed. A mapper-quality regression signal — deliberately excludes the non-residential bypass population (mapper never called; counted separately as INFO).

archetype_t1_fsi_min.description: WF2 archetype T1 (declared-area) plausibility band floor: own_area/lot below this rejects the declared area (garbage filing) and falls to T2, counted. Mirrors the comps permit_fsi band (Spec 78 P3C).

archetype_t1_fsi_max.description: WF2 archetype T1 plausibility band ceiling: own_area/lot above this rejects (multi-phase/complex filings, data errors) and falls to T2, counted. Mirrors the comps permit_fsi band.

archetype_t1_total_cap.description: WF2 archetype T1 absolute cap per DWELLING UNIT: T1 price above cap x max(1, dwelling_units_created) falls to T2, counted (Reality-Check: a 17,841 m2 townhouse-complex filing priced $159.9M as a single project; the per-unit divisor keeps legitimate multi-unit complexes while catching single-unit absurdities).

archetype_t2_reno_line_cap.description: WF2 archetype T2 plausibility cap for RENO lines (gut/addition/kitchen/bath/basement/underpin/garage/suites) on low-rise residential: a propagated line total above this indicates parcel-side data poison (Reality-Check: live $105M gut scalars from a NULL-lot massing mislink) -> fall to T3-if-priceable else T4, counted per line. Don't-hide: the rejection count is an audit row.

archetype_t2_build_line_cap.description: WF2 archetype T2 plausibility cap for BUILD lines (max_build/coa_build) on low-rise residential: above -> fallthrough, counted.

archetype_t2_build_line_min.description: WF2 archetype T2 plausibility floor for BUILD lines: a new-build total below this (sliver-parcel envelopes, Reality-Check found 17 rows <$5K) is not a credible build -> fallthrough, counted.

archetype_t3_total_cap.description: WF3 archetype T3 (rate-table) absolute cap per DWELLING UNIT: a T3 price (rate x own area x premium) above cap x max(1, dwelling_units_created) falls to T4, counted (Reality-Check WF3 2026-07-06: T3 shipped uncapped; 19 rows >$20M, max $159.9M, from oversized/mislinked parent-parcel own-area inflation). $15M/unit is a judgment cut on a continuous corrupted-area curve (not a statistical elbow); the per-unit divisor protects ~60 legitimate 8-222-unit developments. CoA has no dwelling_units_created -> effectively flat $15M for CoA (intended).

cost_ptc_skipped_warn_pct.description: WF1 Spec 83 §3.A OB-3a: permit_type_class_skipped_pct WARN threshold. Default 14.5 = steady-state non-construction rate (~4.5%) + 10pp margin. Catches permit_type_classifications drift if the JOIN starts producing unclassified for previously-classified types.

coa_match_conf_high.description: CoA→permit match confidence at or above which the link is classified as 'high confidence' in the link-coa run summary

coa_match_conf_medium.description: CoA→permit match confidence floor for the 'medium confidence' bucket (link-coa summary: >= this AND < high); also used as the low-confidence boundary in the CoA snapshot

snapshot_coa_conf_high.description: Minimum linked_confidence for a CoA application to be counted as 'high_confidence' in the refresh-snapshot dashboard metrics

spatial_match_max_distance_m.description: Maximum metres between a permit geocode and a parcel centroid for a spatial match (Strategy 3 in link-parcels)

spatial_match_confidence.description: Confidence score assigned to a permit→parcel spatial match (Strategy 3); upgraded to 0.90 if permit geocode falls inside the parcel polygon

coa_unmatched_threshold_pct.description: Day-1 threshold (percent) for unmatched CoAs in link-coa-to-parcels (Spec 42 §6.5 step 9). Above this, audit_table verdict is WARN (not FAIL). Recalibrate post-burn-in.

coa_parcel_conf_tier1a.description: Confidence score for CoA Tier 1a exact-address parcel match in link-coa-to-parcels (addr_num + street_name_normalized both match). DISTINCT from coa_match_conf_high which is consumed by link-coa.js for CoA→permit matching.

coa_parcel_conf_tier1b.description: Confidence score for CoA Tier 1b name-only parcel match in link-coa-to-parcels (street_num absent, only street_name_normalized matches). DISTINCT from coa_match_conf_medium which is consumed by link-coa.js.

coa_scope_unmapped_threshold_pct.description: Day-1 threshold (percent) for unmapped scope_tags in classify-coa-scope (Spec 42 §6.5 step 5). Above this, audit_table verdict is WARN (not FAIL). Recalibrate post-burn-in once production-shape data is known.

coa_trades_unmapped_threshold_pct.description: Day-1 threshold (percent) for CoAs with non-NULL scope_tags but zero trade matches in classify-coa-trades (Spec 42 §6.8 row 667; R5.4 R8 fold #1). Variance-only CoAs (severance, setback, minor-variance) legitimately produce zero trades, so a non-zero threshold is the correct semantic — the spec literal `== 0 FAIL` would be a permanent FAIL. Set to 20% for first burn-in; recalibrate post-prod once tag distribution is known.

coa_active_trades_warn_max.description: WF2 P6.5/P6.6 — WARN ceiling for mean ACTIVE trades per CoA (is_active=true rows) in classify-coa-trades. Post-P6.6 (is_active=!fromBundle) the direct tag-matrix + realtor rows are active; bundle-only recall rows are inactive. Expected ~15; WARN above 18 flags a fan-out regression (e.g. bundle rows reactivated).

permits_bylaw_max_fsi_null_warn_pct.description: WF2 P6.5 — enrich-permits bylaw_max_fsi NULL-rate WARN floor. Nulls are ~100% STRUCTURAL (residential zones regulate by coverage-not-FSI) so this WARNs only above baseline+margin (83.0+5); never FAIL.

permits_bylaw_max_coverage_null_warn_pct.description: WF2 P6.5 — enrich-permits bylaw_max_coverage NULL-rate WARN floor (density zones regulate by FSI-not-coverage). Baseline 66.3+5.75; WARN-above-baseline, never FAIL.

coa_bylaw_max_fsi_null_warn_pct.description: WF2 P6.5 — enrich-permits (coa target) bylaw_max_fsi NULL-rate WARN floor. Baseline 93.9+3; structural nulls, WARN-above-baseline, never FAIL.

coa_bylaw_max_coverage_null_warn_pct.description: WF2 P6.5 — enrich-permits (coa target) bylaw_max_coverage NULL-rate WARN floor. Baseline 59.6+6.4; structural nulls, WARN-above-baseline, never FAIL.

coa_cost_coverage_threshold_pct.description: WF1 Spec 83 SS3.A D3 (CoA OB-2 mirror): coverage WARN threshold. WF2 archetype recalibration: 65 = measured ladder ceiling 68.7% minus margin (cost_coa_total exists on 76.8% of residential CoAs; Severance/Demolition/unlinked consume the rest). Was 70 in the all-safe-skip era.

coa_cost_coverage_fail_pct.description: WF2 archetype (Spec 83 SS3): coverage FAIL threshold. 5 = catches a half-broken CoA ladder (coverage collapsing from ~69% toward zero) — the old default 0 only caught the exact-zero structural break; post-activation the gate must catch regressions too.

coa_inherit_from_permit_min_confidence.description: Minimum fuzzy-match confidence for link-coa.js to inherit a linked permit's authoritative lat/long + ward into the matched CoA (R5.6 Part A — lead-identity continuity, Spec 42 §6.X). Default 0.60 covers Tier 1a (0.95), Tier 1b (0.85), and Tier 2a (0.60) but EXCLUDES Tier 2b (0.50, name-only + permit ward NULL — too speculative for dense urban streets) and Tier 3 (≤0.50, description FTS). Raised from initial 0.50 design per 4-reviewer plan-review (Gemini + DeepSeek + observability worktree converged on Tier 2b risk).

massing_shed_threshold_sqm.description: Building footprint area (m²) below which a secondary structure is classified as a shed in link-massing

massing_garage_max_sqm.description: Maximum building footprint area (m²) for a secondary structure to be classified as a garage in link-massing

massing_nearest_max_distance_m.description: Maximum haversine distance (metres) for the nearest-building fallback in link-massing when no polygon match is found

wsib_fuzzy_match_threshold.description: pg_trgm similarity threshold for Tier 3 fuzzy builder→WSIB name matching; controls both the GIN index filter and the WHERE similarity() comparison

snowplow_buffer_days.description: Days added to today when the Historic Snowplow snaps a fallback-anchor forecast out of the deep past (spec 85 §3). Higher = more lead time before the window opens.

calibration_default_median_days.description: Fallback median days used by compute-trade-forecasts when no calibration data exists for a phase transition (level-5 default)

calibration_default_p25_days.description: Fallback p25 (25th-percentile days) used by compute-trade-forecasts when no calibration data exists for a phase transition (level-5 default)

calibration_default_p75_days.description: Fallback p75 (75th-percentile days) used by compute-trade-forecasts when no calibration data exists for a phase transition (level-5 default)

forecast_default_calibration_warn_pct.description: WF2 D2a (Spec 85 §3.6): compute-trade-forecasts.js default_calibration_pct WARN threshold. At or above this share of forecast rows on the level-5 calibration_method='default', the trade-forecast audit verdict WARNs. STRICT baseline, restored 2026-08-05 by migration 238 after the 2026-07-07 relaxation to 70 (c6310d65) met its own stated revert condition: calibration_cohort_fill_pct recovered past 80% (measured 88.7%, default_calibration_pct 11.3%) once compute_timing_calibration_v2 cohorts grew 32 to 76 on the Phase A inspection drain. Any future relaxation re-arms the calibration_thresholds_relaxed guard, which emits on EVERY run while this exceeds the strict 20 and escalates to FAIL once the corpus recovers.

forecast_default_calibration_fail_pct.description: WF2 D2a (Spec 85 §3.6): compute-trade-forecasts.js default_calibration_pct FAIL threshold. At or above this share on calibration_method='default', the verdict FAILs (blocks nothing — verdict-only, run-chain.js halts on crashes not FAIL verdicts). STRICT baseline, restored 2026-08-05 by migration 238 alongside its warn twin, after the 2026-07-07 relaxation to 85 (c6310d65) was retired. The strict pair is 20/50, mirrored as STRICT_CALIB_WARN_PCT/STRICT_CALIB_FAIL_PCT in compute-trade-forecasts.js; the calibration_thresholds_relaxed guard makes any loosening loud + permanent-by-choice-only.

profiling_coverage_pass_pct.description: assert-global-coverage: coverage >= this integer pct -> PASS (spec 49)

profiling_coverage_warn_pct.description: assert-global-coverage: coverage >= this integer pct -> WARN; below -> FAIL (spec 49)

cost_coverage_pass_pct.description: WF3 F4: assert-global-coverage Step-14 cost_estimates rows PASS floor. Whole-corpus cost coverage is ~62% BY DESIGN under the archetype+safe-skip model (non-residential T4 matrix-miss safe-skip, fit-blocked permissioning, MEC-only nofit are legitimately NULL) — the global 90% bar was inherited indiscriminately and was already red pre-WF2 (40%). Scoped recalibration of these ~6 non-halting observability rows only; global 90/70 untouched (don't blind other row-quality checks). 55 leaves ~7pt headroom over measured 61.8% while still FAILing on a genuine collapse.

coa_lifecycle_transition_stale_days.description: Phase F.1 CoA forecast snowplow staleness gate: if lifecycle_transitions.MAX(transitioned_at) anchor is older than this many days, the CoA forecast becomes snowplow-eligible (treats long-stalled E.2-classified CoAs without subsequent transitions as Rescue Missions). Default 180 = 6 months ≈ p75 of typical CoA decision cohort duration per Spec 84 §7.

coa_gate_calibration_window_days.description: Phase F.1 CoA audit-verdict gate freshness window: compute_phase_calibration must have a permits-chain pipeline_runs row within this many days for the gate to consult its verdict. Older runs trigger no_prior_run state. Default 7 aligns with Spec 48 §3.4 baseline window. Operator may raise this if calibration runs are less frequent than weekly.

coa_gate_force_active.description: Spec 79 §7a WF3 #2 — operator safety valve for compute-trade-forecasts.js CoA audit-verdict gate. 0 = normal gate behavior (calibration verdict + cold-start grace decide). 1 = force CoA writes regardless of calibration verdict; use for post-grace deadlocks where coa_cohort_presence remains 0 after 7 days. When 1, script emits WARN audit row + pipeline.log.warn on every run; reset to 0 once root cause is resolved.

p16_inference_layer_enabled.description: Spec 80 §5.C / P16-D3 [BUG-6] — HARD gate for the lean scope-mapped inference layer in classify-permits.js + classify-coa-trades.js. 0 = OFF (evidence-only emission; 16C/16D wire the code but emit NO inference rows). 1 = ON (the LINE_TRADE_COMPLEMENT lean inference is UNIONed onto evidence at is_active=true / attachment_basis='inference'). Seeded OFF on the 16B GO gate (2026-07-10, hold-out recall 61.4% / prec(insp) 70.5% / mean 10.2); flips to 1 in 16F only AFTER 16E's consumer contract ships. A NO-GO complement cannot ship by accident. The deep_scrapes-resume re-measure can flip it back to 0.

inference_weight.description: Spec 80 §5.C / P16-16E [Gemini MEDIUM pinned] — provenance weight for INFERENCE-basis trade attachments in compute-trade-forecasts.js input aggregation: an inference row's calibration sample is scaled by this factor before classifyConfidence banding (needs 1/weight x the evidence sample for the same confidence band). Ranking/serving authority stays attachment_basis (D5) — this weights, never gates. Panel-adjustable; 0.5 = the pinned default so re-activated inference never re-creates P13-3 full-weight inflation. CONSUMED by scripts/compute-trade-forecasts.js.

enrich_parcels_defer_threshold_rows.description: Phase B B2 (R3-B8, Spec 40 §3.1.2 / Spec 47 §8.7) — row-count threshold that trips enrich-parcels.js's clean scope-defer (chain terminalizes deferred_to_full instead of attempting the pass) when a gated pass's PRE-TRANSACTION scope count exceeds it. Default 50,000 = 10-15x measured-normal decision scope (~3,461/14d) and ~9x under measured-escalated full 5-pass citywide runtime (46.5-53 min); sized against the 08-03 CKAN re-export citywide event (485,567 rows) as the designed defer trigger, not the common case. Every run emits scope_count/threshold/ratio audit rows and WARNs at >=80% of this value (code-side, not a var) so the operator sees the cliff coming before a defer fires. Two CONSECUTIVE defers on the same step escalate to a red verdict (Spec 40 §3.1.2 defer-streak rule) requiring a supervised force-full (ENRICH_PARCELS_FORCE_FULL=1). Threshold is a labeled projection until Phase B B7 measures real per-pass durations against it. CONSUMED by scripts/enrich-parcels.js.

assert_schema_type_sample_rows.description: Spec 122 §1.2a P4 (Pilot 1 remediation) — how many CKAN DataStore rows the permit_cost_type_sample check pulls (`&limit=N`) to prove EST_CONST_COST still parses as a number. 20 = the pre-externalization literal; raise it when CKAN sentinel density ('DO NOT UPDATE'/'DO NOT DELETE' rows) makes 20 rows too thin to contain a single parseable cost, lower it only to cut CKAN load. Bounds are CKAN's own: below 1 the check samples nothing and reads green-by-blindness, above 1000 the DataStore page is slower than the whole step's budget.
